POST $dir.newAccount
payload {}
$code == 201

POST $dir.newOrder
payload {"identifiers": [{"type": "dns", "value": "example.org"}, {"type": "dns", "value": "www.example.org"}, {"type": "dns", "value": "*.example.org"}]}
$code == 201
capture order = $header.Location
capture authz0 = $body.authorizations[0]
capture authz1 = $body.authorizations[1]
capture wildcardAuthz = $body.authorizations[2]

POST-as-GET $authz0
$body.challenges[0].type == http-01
capture chall0 = $body.challenges[0].url
capture token0 = $body.challenges[0].token

POST-as-GET $authz1
capture chall1 = $body.challenges[0].url

# POST-as-GET returns the challenge without starting it.
POST-as-GET $chall0
$body.type == http-01
$body.status == pending
$body.url == $chall0
$body.token == $token0
$body.validated !exists
$header.Link contains <$authz0>;rel="up"

POST-as-GET $authz0
$body.status == pending

# Challenges belong to the account that created the order.
POST $dir.newAccount as account2
payload {}
$code == 201

POST $chall0 as account2
payload {}
error == unauthorized

POST-as-GET $authz0
$body.status == pending

# The payload must be a JSON object.
POST $chall0
payload []
error == malformed

POST $chall0
payload null
error == malformed

POST $chall0
payload {
error == malformed

POST-as-GET $authz0
$body.status == pending

# Without a validation authority, challenges succeed immediately.
POST $chall0
payload {}
$body.type == http-01
$body.status == valid
$body.url == $chall0
$body.token == $token0
$body.validated exists
$body.error !exists
$header.Link contains <$authz0>;rel="up"
capture validated = $body.validated

POST-as-GET $authz0
$body.status == valid
$body.challenges[0].status == valid
$body.challenges[0].validated == $validated
$body.challenges[1] !exists

# The order is ready only once all its authorizations are valid.
POST-as-GET $order
$body.status == pending

# Unknown fields are ignored, and starting a challenge again is a no-op.
sleep 1h

POST $chall0
payload {"keyAuthorization": "ignored"}
$body.status == valid
$body.validated == $validated

POST $chall1
payload {}
$body.status == valid

POST-as-GET $order
$body.status == pending

# Wildcard identifiers have no challenges.
POST-as-GET $wildcardAuthz
$body.challenges == []

POST $wildcardAuthz/challenge/http-01
payload {}
$code == 404
$body.type == https://magnolia-ca.com/acme/error/challengeNotFound

# Unknown challenges and authorizations.
POST $authz1/challenge/dns-01
payload {}
$code == 404
$body.type == https://magnolia-ca.com/acme/error/challengeNotFound

POST $order/authz/3/challenge/http-01
payload {}
$code == 404
$body.type == https://magnolia-ca.com/acme/error/authzNotFound

POST $order/authz/01/challenge/http-01
payload {}
$code == 404
$body.type == https://magnolia-ca.com/acme/error/authzNotFound

POST https://magnolia.test/acme/order/does-not-exist/authz/0/challenge/http-01
payload {}
$code == 404
$body.type == https://magnolia-ca.com/acme/error/orderNotFound

# A fully authorized order is ready.
POST $dir.newOrder
payload {"identifiers": [{"type": "dns", "value": "example.com"}]}
$code == 201
capture order2 = $header.Location
capture order2Authz = $body.authorizations[0]

POST-as-GET $order2Authz
capture order2Chall = $body.challenges[0].url

POST $order2Chall
payload {}
$body.status == valid

POST-as-GET $order2
$body.status == ready
$body.error !exists

# Challenges expire with their order.
sleep 4h

POST $order2Chall
payload {}
$code == 404
$body.type == https://magnolia-ca.com/acme/error/orderNotFound
